verdict.rationale: Deel's REST API and MCP tools expose contracts, people, payroll, and time data as structured JSON (e.g., listOfContracts, contracts endpoint), which could technically be used to pull data out in an open format, but there is no documented 'export all my data' feature, account-closure data-portability process, or bulk export tool aimed at users leaving the platform. Missing for 10: explicit full-account data export capability, documented offboarding/data-portability process, evidence of open-format (CSV/JSON) bulk export for all record types, and any confirmation this covers all user data rather than a subset accessible via API.
